podcast.title: Waco Standoff Playlist
podcast.body: Mitch Miller's Christmas sing-alongs from the 1950s were part of the loud music bombardment directed at the Branch Davidian cult compound in Waco, Texas, in 1993. This was an attempt to psychologically pressure David Koresh and his followers during a 51-day standoff. "That playlist included AQ Breaking Heart by Billy Ray Cyrus, Nancy Sinatra, these boots are made for Wacan, some chanting by Tibetan monks, songs by Andy Williams, and some Christmas sing-alongs by Mitch Miller from the 1950s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Waco Standoff Playlist
xref.body: Andy Williams's songs were part of the playlist used to bombard the Branch Davidian cult compound in Waco, Texas, in 1993. This tactic was an attempt to break the will of David Koresh and his followers during their prolonged standoff with law enforcement. "That playlist included AQ Breaking Heart by Billy Ray Cyrus, Nancy Sinatra, these boots are made for Wacan, some chanting by Tibetan monks, songs by Andy Williams, and some Christmas sing-alongs by Mitch Miller from the 1950s."
